records.name: Use One Delegated Investigator Audit workflow
records.content: Reusable workflow: Use one delegated investigator to audit the command-safety and terminal-inspection implementations and relevant tests. Inspect the actual source, run the relevant existing suites, and produce a useful evidence-based report with limitations. This run has a deliberately small 160,000 cumulative-token worker allowance. Use that allowance efficiently and conclude with observed evidence before exhaustion. Synthesize the result and save reports/release-audit.md. Do not change source or tests or request a larger budget
